title: Why do you need an online portfolio?
excerpt: An online portfolio is a page that showcases your work for others to see. It is also a way for you to share what you do with future employers.
metaTitle: Why do you need an online portfolio?

contentHtml:
What is an online portfolio?

An online portfolio is a page that showcases your work for others to see. It is also a way for you to share what you do with future employers. There are a few different options for creating an online portfolio. Some people create a website, others create a blog, and some people create a social media account that showcases their work.

Each option has their own strengths, for instance, websites tend to look more professional. But, if you're a blogger who is trying to make it big, a blog is perfect because it's in a format that is user friendly and easy to create.

Essential elements of an online portfolio

It's hard to create an online portfolio that catches the eye of potential employers, but there are a few things you can do to make it 'pop'. First and foremost, you need to make sure your portfolio is easily navigable and follows a thematic consistency. Show off your best work first and show it off well; don't hide content on your portfolio!

By resorting to innovative solutions and pushing the boundaries of what's possible, you can amaze any recruiters who land on your portfolio. And finally, if you're a freelancer, you need to make sure your portfolio shows off your skills as a freelancer and conveys your professionalism with ease.

An online portfolio is an essential element for professionals in the digital age. Here are some elements you should make sure to include in your online portfolio. First, you should have a photo of yourself, a short bio, and a link to your website. Second, you should include your most recent projects and some clips of your best work. This can be in the form of text, photos, or video.

The third element is to include the kind of work you want to do, your education, and how you differ from other freelancers. Make sure to make the portfolio mobile-friendly so you can open it on any device!
